column1: # THE ACCEPTANCE MAP — which gates, proof closures and evidence files each acceptance criterion is
# held to. `scripts/gen_acceptance.py` joins this table with the development criteria and the gate
# target/gates.tsv, the trace closure in target/trace-closure.tsv and the registries, and renders
# docs/ACCEPTANCE.md.  Nothing in that document is typed by hand.
# gates:    `S:<name>` (gates separated by `|`) a SOUNDNESS gate (a failure is UNSOUND), `U:<name>` a USEFULNESS gate (a failure is
#           SOUND-BUT-NOT-USEFUL); the name is a gate suite class or a script gate label from scripts/gates.py
# closure:  `O<id>` a registry obligation that must be MECHANIZED; `traces` every trace closure not OPEN;
#           `spatial` no OPEN row in proofs/spatial/STATUS.tsv; `-` none
# evidence: generated files the row rests on (a dirty or missing one makes the row UNMEASURED)
